Your profile, verification documents and private data will never be shared, never be sold and never be available to any employer, government body, recruiter or any third party — under any circumstances.

Any document you upload for verification is used only to grant your badge and stays fully protected: it’s checked, then deleted automatically and permanently as soon as the check is complete. We never keep the image or any copy of it.

In anonymous mode no member or employer can trace your real identity: no name, no age, no contact details — and your anonymous ID is completely separate from your public profile and never linked to it.
Your password is stored encrypted (PBKDF2) and no one can see it — not even us. In this preview, all your data stays on your device.
